user_saw: An opted-in stateless CLI backend forgot earlier turns before the conversation was compacted.
summary: The fix gives stateless CLI turns a recovery reason so opted-in backends replay uncompacted history when the transcript belongs to the same account.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already required a recovery reason for uncompacted replay, and the code before both #96841 and #140294 supplied no reason on ordinary turns without a native session candidate. Those commits changed how native candidates and recovery reasons were handled, but the available history did not establish a previously working path for the reported setup or identify the commit that first shipped the omission.
